partnershipPlan: Two patient partners review the questionnaire process and the plain-language summary for the finance committee; the nurse specialists review the five-minute form.
socialListening: No social media listening; the heart failure support group's newsletter comments are read for themes about follow-up after discharge.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Knowing the nurse would ring every other week kept me from panicking about my ankles swelling.
items.implication: Record phone contacts as part of fidelity and cost.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If the form takes longer than the visit, we will stop filling it in by March.
items.implication: Keep the form under five minutes and review completion monthly.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I can defend a clear statement of what we do not know yet; I cannot defend a number nobody believes.
items.implication: Present the March 2027 answer as measured delivery and cost, not a cost per QALY.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It is an hour each way for Dad, so he only went once.
items.implication: Report reach by distance and consider phone-first visits for remote patients.

summary: Four composite voices on phone follow-up, data burden, the committee's needs and distance.
